escape-with-overlay-open.strategy: fc.record({ overlay: fc.string(), selection: fc.array(fc.record({ kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation'), id: fc.string() })) })

apple-meta-and-shift.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, meta: true, shift: true })).toBe(expectedChord('MacIntel', { key: value, meta: true, shift: true }));

apple-meta-only.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, meta: true })).toBe(expectedChord('MacIntel', { key: value, meta: true }));

apple-no-modifiers.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value })).toBe(expectedChord('MacIntel', { key: value }));

apple-shift-only.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, shift: true })).toBe(expectedChord('MacIntel', { key: value, shift: true }));

arrow-down-key.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: 'ArrowDown', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('⌘⇧Down');

arrow-left-key.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: 'ArrowLeft', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('⌘⇧Left');

arrow-right-key.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: 'ArrowRight', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('⌘⇧Right');

arrow-up-key.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: 'ArrowUp', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('⌘⇧Up');

escape-key.body:
setNavigator('MacIntel', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: 'Escape', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('⌘⇧Esc');

non-apple-meta-and-shift.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, meta: true, shift: true })).toBe(expectedChord('Linux', { key: value, meta: true, shift: true }));

non-apple-meta-only.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, meta: true })).toBe(expectedChord('Linux', { key: value, meta: true }));

non-apple-no-modifiers.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value })).toBe(expectedChord('Linux', { key: value }));

non-apple-shift-only.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, shift: true })).toBe(expectedChord('Linux', { key: value, shift: true }));

other-multicharacter-key.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, shift: true })).toBe('Shift+' + value);

question-mark-key.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: '?', meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('Ctrl+Shift+?');

single-character-key.body:
setNavigator('Linux', '');
expect(formatChord({ key: value, meta: true, shift: true })).toBe('Ctrl+Shift+' + value.toUpperCase());

mixed-element-collections.strategy: fc.record({ node: fc.boolean(), group: fc.boolean(), annotation: fc.boolean(), edges: fc.nat({ max: 5 }) })

case-insensitive-label-match.body:
const node = paletteItem('1', 'Node A', 'element');
expect(filterPaletteItems([node], query)).toEqual([node]);

exact-label-match.body:
const item = paletteItem('1', 'Node A', 'x');
expect(filterPaletteItems([item], query)).toEqual([item]);
exact-label-match.strategy: fc.constantFrom('Node A', 'node a', ' NODE A ', '\tNoDe A\t')

helpers.paletteItem: const paletteItem = (key: string, label: string, detail: string): Parameters<typeof filterPaletteItems>[0][number] => ({ key, label, detail, action: {} as never);

meta-k-opens-palette.body: expect(KEYMAP).toContainEqual({ chord: { key: 'k', meta: true }, command: 'open-palette' });

shift-question-opens-help.body: expect(KEYMAP).toContainEqual({ chord: { key: '?', shift: true }, command: 'open-help' });
